title: ficus ceylanica
intro: Ficus ceylanica, commonly known as Ceylon fig, is a species of fig tree native to Sri Lanka and parts of India. It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Ficus ceylanica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties. Additionally, its leaves are used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, and its extracts have been studied for their potential to reduce oxidative stress and improve cardiovascular health.
